golgotha.text:

choices.text: [TODO:es] Drink to dull the pain to come

drink_consequence.title: Despierto hasta el final
drink_consequence.text:
El amor rechaza el camino más fácil.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse the bitter wine they offer

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You walk to the wood waiting.

nailed.text:

choices.text: [TODO:es] Plead one last time for freedom
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Stay. The work is being done.

nail_curse_consequence.title: Misericordia, no ira
nail_curse_consequence.text:
Desde la cruz, solo amor.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The soldiers fall silent below.

plead_free_consequence.title: La obra se está realizando
plead_free_consequence.text:

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice carries down the hill.

criminals.title: Dos a cada lado
criminals.text:

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Answer hatred with grace.

mock_consequence.text:

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The thief weeps and breathes deep.
